tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// sangs rgyas sman bla mched bdun gyi rjes gnang bya tshul bklag chog don grub bsam 'phel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang sangs rgyas sman bla la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i rjes gnang la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas yid du 'ong bar gzhi bzang po'i steng du mañji'i khar maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu bdun bkod pa'i mthar mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga phyogs mtshams brgyad dang*/ mdun du gtor ma zlum po gsum/ slob dpon kyi mdun du ting shag me tog slob ma la bkye bsdu'i me tog maṇ+ḍal la sogs phyag len ltar bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ ngag tu/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog la zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsā li ni/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha we/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum rol mo dang bcas pas brjod/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi rab du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes nyer gcig dang*/

sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du sangs rgyas sman bla'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis sangs rgyas sman blar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel// dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// bai ḍūr+ya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye gu ru bai ḍūr+ya pra bha rā dzā ya sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pas dug gsum 'joms pa'i a ru ra dang*/ g.yon pas mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng du sman gyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum ngur smrig gsol zhing*/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su pad zla'i steng du mam̐ las rgyal sras nyi ma ltar snang byed sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon pas pad+ma'i sdong bu thugs kar bzung ba'i steng na nyi ma bsnams pa/

g.yon du zla ba'i steng du a las rgyal sras zla ba ltar snang byed sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon pas pad+ma'i sdong bu thugs kar bzung ba'i steng na zla ba bsnams pa/ gnyis ka'ang g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ gtso bo la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sangs rgyas sman bla gtso 'khor gsum gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang*/ 'khor gnyis la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la thim/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā/ zhes nye snying dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bhai ṣa dz+ye gu ru bai ḍūr+ya pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā/ zhes dang*/ spro na sngags ring kyang bzla'o// sngags gnyis ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ rang gi snying ga nas ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la/

oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye gu ru bai ḍūr+ya pra bha rā dzā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs mchod pa gong ltar dang*/ thugs rje kun la sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ 'khor dang gdan rang la thim/ de nas mdun bskyed ni/ maṇ+ḍal la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las dbus dang g.yas g.yon dang*/ de'i phyogs bzhir rin po che'i khri seng ges bteg pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas sman gyi bla sogs nas bzhugs pa/ g.yas su bde bar gshegs pa chos grags rgya mtsho sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon du bde bar gshegs pa mngon mkhyen rgyal po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar du bde bar gshegs pa gser bzang sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ lhor bde bar gshegs pa sgra dbyangs rgyal po sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ nub tu bde bar gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog sku mdog dmar skya mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ byang du bde bar gshegs pa mtshan legs sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang na bza' chos gos rnam gsum ngur smrig gsol zhing rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa/ thugs shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed mkhyen pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis mdzes par byas pa'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas sman bla bde bar gshegs pa bdun dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can sogs nas/ bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha sogs nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbur brgyan/ mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i/ ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs dang*/ bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe// phongs gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag bskyab pa'i phyir// smon lam khyad par can rnams btab gyur pa'i// bde bar gshegs pa bdun la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod nas gtor ma chus sbyangs la/ dang po bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ mchod bstod snga ma ltar dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bcu gnyis la phul/ oṃ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal// sogs nas/ rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gsum pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ gzhi bdag la oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyi phul/ gzhi bdag chen po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/

kun 'grub shog sngags gnyis ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar gsol btab gong bzhin bya'o// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu tshar nas/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la yang ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang*/ khams dang bag la nyal la dgongs nas chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa'i nang nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i sde snod dang*/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las 'dir gsang sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de la yang bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud dang bzhi las/ 'dir bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la yang bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang*/ so so'i rgyud gnyis las 'dir phyi ma yin/ de la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ nor bu'i rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ lngas rtsen gyi rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi rgyud dang drug las da 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud yin/ de la yang rnam pa brgyad yod pa'i nang nas 'dir rigs kyi gtso bo yin/ de la yang bya ba'i rgyud bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'i nang nas sman bla'i mdo brgyad brgya pa dang*/ sman la sngags kyis gdab pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i gzungs rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa sogs kyis bkral ba'i sangs rgyas sman bla mched bdun gyi rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi ba 'os pa thams cad grub nas/

khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud yongs su dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar slob dpon la sangs rgyas sman bla dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i sangs rgyas sman bla gtso 'khor rnams la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos par byas te/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas/ 'grub par shog /ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa sman bla mched bdun dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rang gi ming nas smos te/ zhes bgyi ba la dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po yi dam du slob dpon gyis stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams rjes su gnang ba'i sngon 'gro yin/ rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi la/ byin gyis brlab pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams tha mal par gsal ba'i spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍār+ya 'od kyi rgyal po sku mdog sogs nas/

skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor bde bar gshegs pa mngon mkhyen rgyal po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de'i spyi bor bde bar gshegs pa chos grags rgya mtsho sku mdog dkar dmar phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de'i spyi bor bde bar gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog sku mdog dmar skya mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de'i spyi bor bde bar gshegs pa gser bzang dri med sku mdog ser po chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de'i spyi bor bde bar gshegs pa sgra dbyangs rgyal po sku mdog ser po phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de'i spyi bor bde bar gshegs pa mtshan legs ser po phyag g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang na bza' chos gos rnam gsum ngur smrig gsol zhing pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa/ thugs shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis mdzes par byas pa'i sku can re rer lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa dang bcas bde bar gshegs pa so so'i spyan sngar rim bzhin phyag mchod gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos dang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal pos sngon gyi smon lam ji ltar btab pa bzhin bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis skad cig la 'byor bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bde bar gshegs pa mtshan legs 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas sgra dbyangs rgyal po la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/

de bzhin du mtshan so so'i mgor/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes dang*/ rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po/ gser bzang dri med rin chen snang ba brtul zhugs grub pa/ mya ngan med mchog dpal/ chos grags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs/ chos kyi rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa'i rgyal po/ sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po/ zhes pa rnams kyi mtshan re re nas sbyar ba'i phyag mchod gsol 'debs dang*/ gong ma gong ma 'og ma 'og ma la bstim pa'i tshul rigs 'gre sbyar la/ mthar zhes gsol ba btab pas bde bar gshegs pa sman gyi bla 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar thim pas 'od zer de nyid kyis khyed rang rnams kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag lhag ma bshang gci dang rkang mthil nas nag nur nur bud nas song bas lus shel gong dag pa ltar gyur/ de'i ngang las khyed rang rnams skad cig gis pad zla'i gdan la sangs rgyas sman gyi bla sogs nas/ bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po zhig gsal btab nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab par 'phros pas gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim par mos/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas kyang sangs rgyas sman bla'i lha tshogs che ba ri rab tsam chung ba rdul phran tsam dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug dang ba spu'i bu ga nas mar sib kyis thim nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la gnyis su med par thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyang yang brjod cing ting shag dkrol/

de nyid brtan pa'i phyir du spyi bor me tog bzhag te ngag tu/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye sogs brjod/ zhes pa ni byin gyis brlabs pa'i rjes su gnang ba yin/ sngags kyi rjes gnang gi don du slob dpon gyi thugs kar hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab/ khyed rang rnams sangs rgyas sman blar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gcig gsal bar dmigs nas/ slob dpon la sangs rgyas sman bla dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las sngags phreng byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas bskor du 'khor bar mos nas sngags 'di gnyis kyi rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sngags gnyis bzla/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te slob dpon la me tog nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas slob dpon gyis kyang me tog phreng ba sngags su byas te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos par mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// rdo rje slob ma'i rgyud la sangs rgyas sman bla gtso 'khor rnams kyi gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ da nas bzung ste zhag re la sangs rgyas sman bla'i snying po du tsam 'dren khas len du bcug la/ dam bca' ba'i slad du/ dus da nas bzung ste sangs rgyas sman bla'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ bde bar gshegs pa sman bla mched bdun yi dam du 'dzin cing de'i sngags dam bca' bzhin du nyi ma re la brgya rtsa la sogs pa 'dren snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du sangs rgyas sman bla gtso 'khor rnams yi dam gyi lhar 'dzin cing de'i gsang sngags kyang nyi ma re la brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla ba dam bca' lags so// zhes lan gsum brjod/

phyis kyi dpe kha cig la mtshams 'dir thugs kyi rjes gnang spyi 'gre sbyar 'dug kyang*/ thar rtse paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag dpe dngos la mi 'byung bar ma zad/ yig rnying rnams su'ang mi snang bas rang bzos bcug par nges so// me tog spyi bor bzhag cing*/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas sman bla gtso 'khor rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig de ltar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs brjod/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod dge ba bsngo/ gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs sogs nas/ bde bar gshegs pa bdun la phyag 'tshal lo bar gong ltar/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs brjod/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sangs rgyas sman bla 'grub gyur nas// sogs dang*/ ston mchog dam pa sogs dang*/ nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni skul ba po'i bzhed pa ltar bhik+ṣu ga ga na shrī bha dras e waṃ thar pa rtser myur bar sbyar ba sarba dā maṅga laṃ/ slar yang gong 'og gi char tshig gi gsal byed 'ga' re dang*/ khyad par byin rlabs skabs kyi ngag 'don bklag chog tu bkod pa sogs bya bral ba mañju gho ṣas bgyis pa dge/ ༈ /bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla ma'i rjes gnang gi brgyud 'debs ut+pal phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po shākya'i tog /'jam dbyangs zhi 'tsho khri srong sad na legs// khri ral dpal rdor 'od srung dpal 'khor btsan// skyid lde nyi ma mgon la gsol ba 'debs// bkra shis lde dang lha btsun ye shes 'od// lha lde 'od lde rtse lde dgra bcom pa// shes rab grags pa dar ma rgyal mtshan dang*// dpal ldan gro pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas sgom pa snying po rgyal mtshan zhabs// spru lung pa dang grags dpal bsod nams grags// rgyal sras thogs med 'khus lo dpal ye'i mtshan// seng ge rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog rgyal mtshan grags seng blo bzang pa// mkhyen rab chos rje spyan snga ngag gi dbang*// kun dga' chos grags mchog legs bstan 'dzin bzang*// ngag dbang lhun grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rmor chen rje dang 'jam mgon gnas gsar ba// kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin zhabs// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// sdig ltung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*// bskal brgyar zhabs brtan chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// de ltar bsags las byung ba'i dge tshogs kun// byang chub snying por yongs su bsngos pa'i mthus// bdag gzhan 'gro kun skye ba thams cad du// theg mchog bshes kyis rjes su bzung gyur cig

/srid las nges 'byung tshul khrims rnam par dag /rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtshos rgyud sbyangs shing*// bdag dang phung po rnam rig las 'das pa'i// don dam byang chub sems mchog rtogs par shog /khyad par bde gshegs sman pa'i rgyal po yi// yid 'ong mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan legs bsgoms shing*// gzungs sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod brtson pa'i mthus// sgrib gnyis rgyur bcas lhag med 'jil gyur cig /gzhan yang nad gdon nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing*// tshe dpal 'byor pa'i skal bzang rab rgyas nas// gnas skabs mthar thug phan dang bde ba yi// chos mthun bsam sbyor yid bzhin 'grub par shog /tshe yi mthar yang bde gshegs sras bcas kyis// mngon sum rjes bzung gsung gis dbugs dbyung zhing*// dag pa'i zhing du rdzus te skyes nas kyang*// don gnyis myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang dge slong gu ṇa lak+ṣ+mi'i bzhed skong du chos smra ba'i gzugs brnyan mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi rastu// ༈ /sman bla gtso 'khor gsum gyi sgom bzlas la brten nas bsnyen pa bya tshul sogs nyung gsal kun phan bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dzā ya/ bcom ldan 'das sman pa'i rgyal po gtso 'khor gsum gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang dang lung legs par thob cing*/ khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa khrus dang gtsang sbra'i kun spyod la gtso bor gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i bsam gtan gyi khang bur phyag dar byas te/ rang gi mdun du sman bla gtso 'khor rnams kyi bris 'bur gyi sku gang rigs bshams pa'i spyan sngar gtor ma dkar zlum che chung gnyis/ gzhi bdag gtor ma/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya/ cha gsum btang la mtshams bcad/

skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar paṇa chen nam mkha' dpa' bzang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ltar nyams su blang*/ bzlas pa'i mjug tu spro na/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes la sogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la mchod bstod byas nas 'khor dang gdan rang la thim zhes pa'i bar dkyus ltar la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sangs rgyas sman bla 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo smon bya/ snga thun gyi mthar/ 'khor dang gdan rang la thim pa'i rjes su/ mchod gtor bsang sbyang byin rlabs dkyus bzhin la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa bdun la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs gtor mgron spyan drang*/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ gtor ma 'bul ba dkyus bzhin/ gzhi bdag gtor ma rgyun du ma phul kyang chog mthar yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang med pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs gong bzhin mthar/ shis brjod bcas bya/ thun mtshams su grub na mdo lugs kyi phyag mchod rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba dang*/ ma grub kyang sman mdo che chung ji ltar rigs pa gdon/ de lta bu'i rim pas bsnyen tshad gzungs thung 'bum phrag gcig kha skong dang bcas pa bzla ba yin la/ thun so so'i mthar gzungs 'bring po ci nus dang*/ khyad par/ tad+ya thā/ ghu me ghu me/ i me ni mi hi/

ma ti ma ti/ sap+ta ta thā ga ta sa ma dh+yā dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ a ti ma te/ sā le/ pā pam̐ sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ nā sha ya/ ma ma bud+dha/ bud+dhot+ta me/ u me ku me/ bud+dha k+ṣe tra pa ri sho dha ni/ dha me ni dha me/ me ru me ru/ me ru shi kha re/ sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu ni bā ra ṇi/ bud+dhe su bud+dhe bud+dhā dhiṣ+ṭhā na/ rak+ṣan+tu me/ sarba de bā sa me a sa me sa man+tā ha ran+tu me/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ sha me sha me/ pra sha man+tu me sarba id+yu pa dra ba byā dha ya/ pū ra ṇi pū ra ṇi/ pū ra ya me/ sarba ā kā shā ya/ bai ḍūr+ya pra ti bhā se sarba pā paṃ k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ zhes pa'i gzungs ring 'di nyer gcig re la nyung mtha' byas pa bzla ba shin tu gal che/ gzhan mtshams kyi skabs spang blang sogs bya rgyud kyi bsnyen pa spyi ltar shes par byas la nyams su blang ngo*// de ltar 'bad pas bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs shing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ba dang*/ las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa dang*/ tshe yi mthar yang bcom ldan 'khor bcas mngon sum du mthong zhing dag pa'i zhing du skye bar 'gyur ba sogs phan yon mtha' yas par gsungs so// yang rang gzhan la phan gdags pa'i slad du gzungs sgrub byed par 'dod na/ mdun du bris sku'i spyan sngar stegs kyi khar bum pa dri bzang gi chus gang ba kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa'i steng du/ dung chos mchod yon gyis bkang ba dang*/ gzungs thag rdo rje bcas bsham/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa tshar du dngar bas mdzes par bya/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'i nang du/ hrīḥlas pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba rang sgra sgrog bzhin pas 'khod par gyur/

ces brjod la/ mdo chog las 'byung ba'i 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang byug pa sogs nas/ 'bul lo mchod do zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal bai ḍūr+ya'i gzungs sngags mthu dang nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa khyed kyis bdag dang bsgrub bya dmigs bsal yod na de'i ming gzhug sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa sbyang ba dang*/ chos kyi rtogs pa khyad par can skye bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ gzungs thag nas bzung te/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas dung chos kyi chu la phog de lud nas bum pa'i nang du lhung ba yig 'bru rnams la thim pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes pa'i dmigs pa dang sbyar te gzungs ring gtso bor bzla zhing*/ thun 'jog pa na mchod pa gong ltar dang*/ dung chos kyi chu mchod yon du phul te gsol ba gdab pas yig 'bru rnams 'od du ltem gyis zhu ba las bum pa'i chu gzungs sngags kyi nus pa mtha' dag dang ldan par bsam/ de ltar thun du bcad nas zhag bdun sogs ji ltar rigs pa bsgrubs pa'i mthar rang nyid kyis bkru ba dang btung ba sogs bya/ bsgrub bya gzhan la byed na bkru byabs srung gsum mam bkru ba dang shis brjod rgyas par byas pas nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi zhing sgrib gnyis yongs su byang ba dang*/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa sogs gzungs sngags kyi phan yon ji skad bshad pa rnams 'thob par 'gyur la/ gshin po'i rus pa dang dur khrod kyi sa gzhi sogs la 'thor bas dmigs yul gyi ngan song du skye ba'i las kyi sgrib pa byang bas mtshon yon tan mtha' yas shing*/ tshul de bzhin du bye ma'am/ yungs kar sogs la bsngags nas 'thor bas kyang rung bar gsungs so// zhes pa'ang rang gzhan mang po la phan pa'i bsam pa kho nas yig cha snga ma 'ga' zhig gi don mdor bsdus te shākya'i dge slong bya bral ba mañju gho ṣas sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol te byang chub snying po'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig

shu bhaṃ// ༈ /sman bla'i sgom bzlas shin tu bsdus pa phan bde'i myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dzā ya/ 'dir sman bla'i sgom bzlas mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len par 'dod pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// sogs skyabs sems lan gsum dang*/ sems can thams can bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan gyi steng*// rang sems hūm̐ yig 'od kyis don gnyis bsgrubs// tshur 'dus bdag nyid bcom ldan sman gyi bla// sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgyas a ru ra// g.yon pas mnyam gzhag bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed bsnams// mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar chos gos rnam gsum gsol// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// g.yas su rgyal sras nyi ltar snang byed dmar// phyag g.yon nyi mas mtshan pa'i pad+ma bsnams// g.yon du zla ltar snang byed sku mdog dkar// phyag g.yon zla bas mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dzin// gnyis ka g.yas pas mchog sbyin phyag rgya mdzad// dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs gtso bo la// 'dud pa'i tshul gyis pad zla'i gdan la bzhengs// gtso 'khor kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan// de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun// bcom ldan sman gyi bla ma'i rnam pa ru// mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis med thim// thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs// sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje byin rlabs kun// tshur 'dus bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab par gyur// tad+yathā/ oṃ bhai ṣā dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dza sa mud+ga te swā hā/ zhes ci nus dang*/ spro na gzungs ring kyang bzla/

mthar bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ya rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel// dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// bai ḍūr+ya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi blas// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes bstod cing gsol ba gdab la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ 'khor dang gdan 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sangs rgyas sman bla 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo smon bya/ bsnyen pa byed na khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas gzungs thun 'bum phrag gcig kha skong dang bcas pa bzla/ thun mtshams su phyag mchod rgyas bsdus gang rigs sam/ sman mdo che chung ji ltar nus pa bklag par bya'o// zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i slad du mang du thos pa'i bya bral ba mañju gho ṣas sbyar ba ste/ dge bas 'gro kun phan bde'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sman bla bde gshegs bdun la gsol ba gdab tshul khyer bde bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ'adir sman bla mched bdun la gsol pa gdab tshul ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas dam chos dge 'dun la// byang chub bar du gus pas bdag skyabs mchi// 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir// bde gshegs bdun la gsol ba gdab par bgyi// lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// sku mdog sngon po phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyis// a ru ra dang g.yon pas mnyam gzhag steng*// sman gyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams// de yi spyi bor mngon mkhyen rgyal po ni// sku mdog dmar po mchog sbyin mnyam gzhag mdzad// de yi spyi bor chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs// sku mdog dkar dmar phyag gnyis chos 'chad mdzad// de yi spyi bor mya ngan med mchog dpal// sku mdog dmar skya phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad// de yi spyi bor gser bzang dri med ni// sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis chos 'chad mdzad// de yi spyi bor sgra dbyangs rgyal po ni// sku mdog ser po mchog sbyin mnyam gzhag mdzad// de yi spyi bor mtshan legs yongs bsgrags dpal// sku mdog ser po skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag mdzad// thams cad chos gos gsum gsol mtshan dpes spras// pad zla'i gdan la skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// mtshan snyan ga bur zegs ma reg tsam gyis// mnar med me yang rab bsil pad mtsho ltar// sgyur mdzad snyigs ma'i mgon po mched bdun la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags// dge la yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs// 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// bcom ldan gdan 'dzom chen po dgongs su gsol// bde gshegs bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam dang*// shākya'i bstan pa lnga brgya'i tha ma la// 'grub par 'gyur bar zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin// bdag la bden pa mngon sum bstan du gsol// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// lan bdun/

de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po 'od du zhu nas sgra dbyangs rgyal po la thim par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal= lan bdun brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sgra dbyangs rgyal po 'od du zhu nas gser bzang dri med la thim par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzang dri med rin chen snang ba brtul zhugs grub pa la= lan bdun brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzang dri med 'od du zhu nas mya ngan med mchog dpal la thim par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal la= lan bdun brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal 'od du zhu nas chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la thim pa gyur/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la=lan bdun brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs 'od du zhu nas mngon mkhyen rgyal po la thim pa gyur/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa'i rgyal po la= lan bdun brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa mngon mkhyen rgyal po 'od du zhu nas sman pa'i rgyal po la thim par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po la= lan bdun brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sman pa'i rgyal po 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas sman pa'i rgyal po'i skur gyur ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur/ tad+yathā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye bhe+ai ṣa dz+ye ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā/ bzla/ bde gshegs mched bdun phyag mchod mtshan bzlas dges// gang gis sngon tshe btab pa'i smon lam mchog

/brgyad gnyis bzhi bzhi bcu gnyis grangs ldan pa// bdag sogs 'gro bas deng 'dir 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*/ ku sā li dharmā badz+ra gyi gsung las btus nas ban gzugs dharma bha dras rang gi nyams len du bris/ sarba maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
